from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ReceivableEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single reported value for a receivable line item found in a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the financial statement belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year end associated with this specific amount (e.g., '2021', '2022')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the line item as written in the statement (e.g., 'Other receivables, related party')")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The monetary value reported for the line item and year")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted financial data points from the document collection."""
    receivable_entries: list[ReceivableEntry]
